Amazon Web Services is seeking an Electronic Health Record Principal Sales Executive to drive revenue growth by helping healthcare provider customers adopt Epic on AWS and transform their healthcare organizations as part of this initiative.

Do you have a passion for building relationships with hospital system executives and helping them realize the business value of cloud computing and AI in support of patient care? Would you like to help set the strategy for helping provider customers get the most out of their Epic application, data, and patient care functions?

Do you have a track record of delivering strategic wins and exceeding revenue targets by helping provider customers drive compelling business outcomes? Are you energized by partnering with customers to position AWS as the platform of choice for mission-critical clinical, operations and financial healthcare systems?

Would you like to influence AWS's strategy on how we help our customers drive value in the Epic EHR ecosystem?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced and motivated sales/business development professional who aligns with our Leadership Principles and possesses a unique balance of healthcare industry expertise, is comfortable with C-suite conversations, and has consultative selling skills.

You will own strategy, key customer win goals, and revenue targets across a portfolio of healthcare provider accounts, driving adoption of AWS services for Epic EHR workloads.
In collaboration with Solutions Architects, healthcare solution, business development, and partner teams, you will identify key customer accounts, develop account strategies, and lead/coach teams to win strategic multi-year deals.

As a trusted advisor to health system executives, you will help organizations build the business case for migrating Epic environments—including production, alternate production, integrated real-time environments (IRE), data and disaster recovery—to AWS.

You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a go-to-market strategy to build mindshare and accelerate AWS adoption within the healthcare provider segment, specifically focused on Epic EHR.

The ideal candidate must be self-motivated with a proven track record of delivering strategic wins and meeting revenue targets while operating at the C-suite level for healthcare providers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value—including TCO reduction, operational resilience, and clinical outcomes—is critical.

You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about territory planning, competitive positioning, and long-term account growth.
We are looking for someone who is passionate about the following: Our company credo: "Work hard. Have fun. Make history." In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.

Enjoy working with healthcare provider executives. You will have a passion for understanding hospital system priorities—cost optimization, operational efficiency, clinical innovation—and positioning AWS as the platform that delivers on those priorities for Epic EHR and associated clinical workloads.

Have a strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles in healthcare IT.
The ideal candidate will have past experience selling technology solutions to hospital systems, health system C-suites, and IT leadership. You will enjoy developing deep customer relationships and account strategies, leveraging your healthcare domain knowledge to earn trust at the executive level. You will regularly collaborate with Solutions Architects, Partner teams, and AWS service teams to bring the full power of AWS to bear on customer opportunities.

· Own and exceed annual revenue targets by driving AWS adoption for Epic EHR workloads across a portfolio of healthcare provider accounts
· Coach and mentor sellers on how to develop winning Epic EHR and ecosystem proposals
· Develop and execute account plans that identify migration opportunities, map stakeholder relationships, and define a path from first engagement through close
· Build and maintain a robust pipeline through prospecting, executive networking, industry events, and collaboration with AWS partner and marketing teams
· Lead complex, consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders—translating technical solution value into financial and operational business outcomes for CFOs, CIOs, CTOs, and clinical leadership
· Partner closely with Solutions Architects to ensure proposed solutions meet customer requirements and position AWS competitively against alternative hosting options
· Engage Systems Integrator (SI) partners to support deal progression, including joint selling motions, SOW development, and commercial structuring
· Negotiate and close multi-year commitments, including Enterprise Discount Programs (EDPs), Private Pricing Agreements (PPAs), and migration-linked investment packages
· Serve as the voice of the customer internally—advocating for product enhancements, service improvements, and go-to-market investments that accelerate Epic on AWS adoption
· Build deep, trust-based relationships with senior executives within hospital systems (CEOs, CFOs, CIOs, CTOs, VP Infrastructure) to establish AWS as a long-term strategic partner
· Contribute to the broader AWS Healthcare sales community by sharing best practices, win/loss insights, and reusable deal strategies

Diverse Experiences — AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture — Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth — We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance — We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

We will improve millions of lives by making this transformative treatment universally accessible. Joining us means you’ll be part of a rapidly growing startup with significant equity opportunities and a major impact on our future.

Role Overview: Ampa is hiring our first dedicated full cycle sales representative to sell our TMS system to psychiatrists, clinic owners, and mental health practices across the US.

You will own the entire sales motion, from generating your own pipeline to running demos to closing deals. This is high-ticket capital equipment subscription to physician decision-makers, and you will work directly with our founding team as we scale a proven product into a growing market.

You should be able to walk us through the specific deals that got you to your number Proven ability to break into new accounts and build channels from scratch, without relying on the infrastructure of a large company Consultative, substance-first selling style.

Our buyers are psychiatrists who respond to clinical credibility, ROI clarity, and intelligence Comfort with long sales cycles and cash-pay ROI conversations with practice owners Startup mindset: resourceful, persistent, and energized by ambiguity Why Join Ampa? Impact: Lead the growth of transformative mental health technologies.

Growth: Thrive in a startup environment with rapid innovation. Stability: Enjoy startup benefits with a secure product line. Ownership: Receive substantial equity as an early team member. Logistics: Work Mode: Remote Location: US Employment: Full-time Originally posted on Himalayas

Candidates must be located within a reasonable commuting distance (approximately one hour) of a major or semi-major airport in the U.S. About Teton Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care- using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the resident and care environment.

Our proprietary computer vision system enables staff to automate documentation, proactively manage resident acuity, and streamline workflows across entire facilities.

From assisted living communities to hospital wards, our system delivers unprecedented access to real-time data insights, empowering providers with actionable intelligence to enhance decision-making and elevate care delivery.

With strong demand and a clear product-market fit, this role represents our fourth strategic sales hire in the U.S., focused on scaling our presence across the East Coast. It's a rare opportunity to drive market expansion and define how we win in one of our highest-potential regions.

Role Overview We’re looking for a Business Development Representative to help drive our U.S. growth. This position is heavily focused on outbound prospecting, with an emphasis on opening doors and building relationships at the executive and C-suite level in the senior living industry.

Candidates will need to bring both persistence and sophistication to their outreach- balancing high activity with thoughtful engagement of senior decision-makers.

This role offers direct exposure to enterprise sales cycles and close collaboration with leadership, making it an excellent opportunity for someone looking to advance their career in strategic business development. Drive a high-volume outbound prospecting model (LinkedIn, email, and phone), using strategic, AI-driven methods to reach and engage senior executives and C-suites in senior living. Build and manage early-stage relationships with C-suite and executive stakeholders, preparing the ground for the Business Development Director.

Prepare outreach plans, activity schedules, and tailored messaging to meet pipeline targets. Support conferences and industry events by helping to set meetings and manage executive-level follow-up. Track activity, pipeline progress, and outreach performance in the CRM with attention to detail.

Stay current on competitors, industry trends, and market dynamics to sharpen prospecting strategy. Contribute to team projects and GTM initiatives as assigned. Always tie your work to Teton ’s mission of empowering caregivers and improving the quality of life for residents in senior living.

What You’ll Need 1–3 years of experience in business development, sales development, or a related outbound role, with a strong track record of achieving growth targets. Proven ability to engage and hold conversations with senior executives and C-suites Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

A self-starter mentality with excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Comfortable with high-volume outbound prospecting while also contributing strategically to pipeline generation. Thrives in a high-activity sales environment with significant daily call volume.

Passionate about building a career in sales while making a meaningful impact in healthcare- helping caregivers work more efficiently and improving quality of life for residents in senior living communities. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Must have a valid driver’s license.

Candidates must reside in the U.S. and be within commuting distance to a major/semi-major airport. Why Join Teton Be part of a company transforming senior living care with cutting-edge technology. Gain direct exposure to enterprise deal cycles and executive-level sales strategy.

Clear growth path into senior business development and sales roles, including ownership of multi-stakeholder opportunities. Opportunity to make a measurable impact at an early stage in Teton ’s U.S. expansion. What It’s Like Working at Teton We’re a growing team of extremely hard-working and talented people.

The learning curves are steep, and expanding your skill set is not just encouraged- it’s expected. It’s a hands-on environment where you’ll be challenged, supported, and constantly learning. We are looking for people who believe in our long-term vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship rather than just another 9-5 job.

With us you will have an opportunity to truly make an impact on the world with the outcomes of your work. So, if you are looking for a ride and not just a job- jump on board 😊 Originally posted on Himalayas

Remote Business Development Representative Job Description About emagineHealth emagineHealth is a full-service marketing agency built exclusively for the life sciences industry. For more than 30 years, we have served pharma, biotech, medical device, diagnostics, and drug development services companies.

We are a team of approximately 50 people who show up every day to help the companies advancing health and wellbeing worldwide tell better stories and build stronger commercial functions. The Role We are looking for a Business Development Representative who thinks like a marketer and sells like a strategist.

This person will own the new business pipeline, from prospecting through close, and will be the external face of everything we are building at emagineHealth.

We are hiring someone who genuinely understands the way marketing creates commercial value in the life sciences, who can diagnose a client's challenge before they even articulate it, and who can walk into a room of senior decision-makers and credibly represent the thinking behind our approach.

If you have run marketing at a life sciences agency, or served as a marketing strategist and then moved into sales, you are exactly who we are describing. The industry knowledge is a bonus. The marketing knowledge and consultative sales approach is non-negotiable. Responsibilities This is an autonomous role. You run your own pipeline.

You are responsible for outreach, discovery, proposal development, and close. You will work closely with the VP of Commercial Strategy on deal strategy, with the account management team on handoffs, and with our management team on crafting pitches.

Day-to-day, that looks like: Building and managing a qualified pipeline of life sciences prospects (CDMOs, CROs, biotech, pharma, med device, diagnostics, and eClinical companies), targeting marketing and commercial decision-makers at the VP and C-suite level Running discovery calls that actually uncover the client's business problem, not just their project list.

You diagnose before you prescribe. Leading proposal and pitch development in partnership with the VP of Commercial Strategy. You do not just oversee the deck, you shape the narrative. You know why the story matters, not just how to build the slides.

Managing 3 to 9 month deal cycles across multiple stakeholders (marketing, BD, commercial leadership, procurement, medical affairs, etc.). You know how to navigate a buying committee. Identifying expansion opportunities within the sales process. You can see a broader AOR relationship where a client initially sees a single project.

Maintaining CRM hygiene and providing accurate pipeline forecasting. You own your numbers. Representing emagineHealth at industry conferences (CPHI, BIO, SCOPE, and others) with the goal of building a network of executives who already know us before they need us. Acting as the internal bridge between market intelligence and service delivery.

You surface what you are hearing in the market and you bring that back to the team so our capabilities stay aligned with what buyers actually need. Who We Are Looking For There is a profile of a person that will succeed here and a profile of person that will not. We are being direct about both.

Marketing Foundation: You understand how marketing works. You have either run marketing programs yourself or you have sat close enough to the strategy side that you can speak to brand positioning, digital channels, content strategy, and why the website matters before you even think about paid media.

Sales Instinct: You know how to qualify fast, follow up without being annoying, read a room, and push a deal forward without pushing the prospect away. You understand that consultative selling in a relationship-driven industry like life sciences is a long game and you have the patience and the discipline for it.

Autonomy: You do not need hand holding. You figure things out. When you hit an obstacle, you first try to brainstorm a solution and then consult others. Agency life is fast and sometimes ambiguous, and you are comfortable in that environment. You build your own structure where structure does not yet exist. Speed: This is an agency.

Response time matters. Follow-through matters. You are someone who moves quickly, keeps commitments, and makes it easy for people to work with you. Commercial Intelligence: You understand pricing, margins, and what makes a deal actually profitable.

You understand that the deals you bring in affect the financial health of the organization, and you take that seriously. Executive Presence: You can hold a room. You are comfortable presenting to CMOs, VPs of Commercial, and founders who have strong opinions. You do not shrink when challenged.

You come prepared, and when you do not know something, you say so and get back to them. Industry Experience Life sciences experience is strongly preferred. If you have worked in pharma, biotech, CRO, CDMO, or adjacent sectors (either in-house or at an agency serving those clients), you are ahead of the curve.

If you do not have deep life sciences experience but have a strong marketing and sales background within B2B clients, let’s have a serious conversation. The industry can be learned. The mindset cannot. What Success Looks Like in Year One A qualified pipeline is built and actively moving.

You are running multiple deals at different stages simultaneously. You have attended at least one major industry conference and have meaningful new relationships to show for it. You met or exceeded your Quota. The VP of Commercial Strategy trusts you to run deals independently and looks to you as a thought partner on pipeline strategy.

The internal team sees you as a partner, not someone who overpromises during the sale and underdelivers at kickoff. You have contributed at least one piece of market intelligence that has meaningfully shaped our positioning or service approach.

Perks of Joining the emagine Team Opportunity to collaboratively work with top-tier talent A “family-like” environment will make you feel at home from your first day No micromanaging or breathing down your neck A culture of trust, appreciation for one another, and respect A company that recognizes that work can’t always be fun, but strives every day to keep it fun and enjoyable On the job training and development Medical and Dental insurance 401(k) with match Graduated PTO/Vacation Policy Professional Development reimbursement Employee referral incentive “HeyTaco” app on Slack allows employees to give thanks, praise and accolades to coworkers and cashed in for rewards or donated to charity Competitive salary Fitness/Wellness Reimbursement Paid vacation Personal days Opportunity to give back to the community **U.S. based applications only please.

## About Outsite
Outsite is a global coliving company for remote workers — hotel-quality service, extended-stay flexibility, and a built-in community, at the intersection of hospitality and lifestyle. We operate 40+ properties across 21+ cities on 5 continents, with 6,000+ verified members and an NPS of 65.
## About Outsite for Teams
Outsite for Teams is Outsite's B2B expansion — giving companies, teams, and communities access to our global network of coliving and coworking spaces for their employees. Rather than a bulk discount, we position it as a meaningful perk: founders and leaders purchase memberships on behalf of their team, and a dedicated account manager keeps them active and engaged. This is a genuine growth priority for the business, and you'll be one of the first dedicated sales hires driving it.

We're hiring a Business Development Representative to build and run outbound sales for Outsite for Teams. You'll identify and prospect the right companies, run discovery calls, and close new business — turning remote-first startups, distributed teams, and growth-stage companies into long-term Outsite for Teams accounts.
This is a highly autonomous, build-it-yourself role. You'll help shape the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's.

### 1. Prospecting & Outbound
· Build and work target lists of remote-first and hybrid companies, using signals like team size (50–500), remote/hybrid language in company descriptions, and titles such as Head of People, Chief of Staff, VP of Operations, or Founder
· Source leads via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Wellfound/AngelList, Crunchbase, remote job boards (We Work Remotely, Remote.co), and Outsite's own member base
· Run cold outbound via email, LinkedIn, and calls, and continuously test and refine messaging
· Reach out to local companies near Outsite locations to sell business travel and corporate stay packages
· Build partnerships with travel agencies and tour operators to generate referral and bundled-stay opportunities
### 2. Sales & Pipeline Management
· Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's team, travel patterns, and remote work culture
· Own the full sales cycle from first touch to close
· Keep the CRM clean and current — every deal staged, every next step logged
· Forecast pipeline accurately and hit monthly/quarterly new business targets
### 3. Collaboration & Handoff
· Partner with the Head of Marketing on positioning, collateral, and campaigns that support outbound
· Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the account management side, with full context on the client's goals
· Share market feedback — what's resonating, what isn't — to sharpen Outsite for Teams' pitch and ICP over time
### 4. Reporting
· Report weekly on pipeline: volume, stage, conversion, and blockers
· Track and share what's working in outbound so it can be systematized

· 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (SDR/BDR background a plus)
· Confident, consultative communicator — comfortable running discovery calls with founders and People leaders
· Self-starter who's built pipeline from scratch, not just worked warm leads
· Able to work autonomously and independently
· Comfortable with taking initiative and being proactive
· Comfortable working European timezone hours
· Strong written communication — outbound copy is part of the job
· Organized; keeps a CRM honest without being told to
· Comfortable using AI in workflow

· Experience selling to remote-first or distributed teams
· Familiarity with Pipedrive or HubSpot
· Existing network in the startup, remote work, or travel/hospitality space
· Experience selling a membership, subscription, or perk-style product
## What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)
· A working, documented outbound playbook (lists, messaging, cadence)
· A full and accurately-staged pipeline in the CRM
· First qualified meetings booked and first deals in late-stage or closed
· Clear, weekly reporting rhythm established with Marketing
· Sharpened point of view on which ICPs convert fastest

· Remote, travel encouraged
· Credits for Outsite locations
· Salary - $45,000 - $50,000 USD + commission

s.h: What It’s Like to Work at YipitData
s.t:

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

SpendHound is a software vendor management platform and benchmarking service launched by YipitData. We’ve experienced explosive growth by re-defining the business model for this category. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
Advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
Software and AI benchmarks across more than 10,000 vendors to help negotiate better rates across vendors
Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.

We are seeking a Sales Associate to play a crucial role on the SpendHound team. As a Sales Associate, you will join the go-to-market team of this new division and assist in acquiring new clients. Your responsibilities will include qualifying and following up with inbound leads and marketing-qualified opportunities, and proactively generating leads through outbound activity. You are then responsible for managing a full sales cycle and closing those new business opportunities.
This role is part of a new start-up team, but with the resources of a larger company. As such, you will gain experience in an earlier-stage sales environment with frequent iteration and the opportunity to take on additional responsibilities outside the general scope of your work.
This position offers an exciting opportunity for growth and advancement within a brand-new segment for the company.

## Das erwartet dich ##
Bei der Mobiliar Generalagentur Wil legen wir Wert auf nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen und hohe Servicequalität. Im Verkaufssupport leistest du einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur zielgerichteten Unterstützung unseres Beraterteams und zur professionellen Betreuung unserer Kundinnen und Kunden.

Dafür suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die unsere Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeberaterinnen und -berater im Tagesgeschäft unterstützt und aktiv zur verlässlichen Betreuung unserer Kundschaft beiträgt.

Mit deiner strukturierten Arbeitsweise und deinem Dienstleistungsverständnis stärkst du das Vertrauen in die Mobiliar als persönlichste Versicherung der Schweiz.
## Das bewirkst du bei uns ##
Du unterstützt unsere Versicherungsberaterinnen und -berater im operativen Alltag und übernimmst eigenverantwortlich administrative und koordinierende Aufgaben.
Dazu gehören die Erstellung von Korrespondenz, Auswertungen sowie die Bearbeitung von Offerten, Anträgen und Vertragsunterlagen. Im direkten Kundenkontakt am Telefon oder am Schalter betreust du unsere Kundschaft kompetent und verlässlich.
Du beantwortest Anfrage und koordinierst Termine über sämtliche Versicherungsbranchen hinweg. Als Teil des Verkaufssupportteams arbeitest du eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen und stellst reibungslose Abläufe sicher.
## Das bringst du mit ##
* Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung und oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung innerhalb der Versicherungsbranche
* Ausbildung Versicherungsvermittler oder Versicherungsvermittlerin VBV oder Bereitschaft, diese zu absolvieren
* Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein
* Interesse an einem vielseitigen Tätigkeitsfeld und Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen
* Strukturierte, selbständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise Teamorientierung, hohe Hilfsbereitschaft und professionelle Grundhaltung
## Bei uns arbeiten ##
Auf der Generalagentur Wil erwartet dich ein engagiertes und vielfältiges Team. Gemeinsam stärken wir unsere regionale Verankerung und schaffen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden konsistente 5 Sterne Erlebnisse. Wir pflegen einen offenen, respektvollen und kollegialen Austausch und arbeiten lösungsorientiert sowie verantwortungsbewusst zusammen. Dich erwarten klare Strukturen, kurze Entscheidungswege, eine sorgfältige Einführung sowie zeitgemässe Anstellungsbedingungen bei der Mobiliar.
Dein Arbeitsort ist auf unserer Hauptagentur in Ebnat-Kappel und der Stellenantritt erfolgt nach Vereinbarung.
Das Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz verlangt zur Ausübung dieser Funktion den Abschluss Versicherungsvermittler/-in VBV, Profil Allbranche. Sollte dieser nicht vorhanden sein, unterstützen wir gerne mit massgeschneiderten internen Ausbildungen.
## Das bieten wir ##
##### Erfolgsbeteiligung #####
Sind wir erfolgreich, profitieren auch unsere Mitarbeitenden. Jedes Jahr wird über die Ausschüttung einer Erfolgsbeteiligung und deren Höhe entschieden.
##### Weiterbildung und Entwicklung #####
Wir bieten ein vielfältiges internes Kursangebot an. Bei jobrelevanten Weiterbildungen beteiligen wir uns.
##### Vergünstigungen #####
Wir bieten unter anderem bis zu 25% Prämienrabatt, Rabatte auf Mobiltelefone sowie kostenlose Abonnemente mit Flatrate und Ermässigungen bei kulturellen Veranstaltungen.

* Beratung unserer Kunden in der Finanzindustrie beim Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Infrastruktur und Prozessen rund um Crypto Assets.
* Konzeption und Aufbau von HSM / PKI Infrastrukturen.
* Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von Key Ceremonies, unter Einhaltung von Standards wie ISA3000.
## Dieser Job ist für dich, wenn ##
* Du mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung zu kryptografischen Themen (Verschlüsselung, Signatur, Authentifizierung, Hashwertverfahren) einschliesslich Quantum Safe Verfahren mitbringst.

* Du Erfahrungen im Bereich IT-Security / Datenschutz sowie in den entsprechenden Security Standards (z. B. ISO 27001 / 2, NIST 800 Series, DSGVO, BSI Grundschutz, ITIL Foundation) mitbringst.
* Du Kenntnisse in der Durchführung von Key Ceremonies im Crypto-Asset-Umfeld besitzt.
* Du Erfahrungen in der Entwicklung von Sicherheitskonzepten, Security Policies und ähnlichen Dokumentationen hast.
* Du fliessend Deutsch und Englisch sprichst.
* Du technische Kenntnisse in Hardware Security Modulen (z. B. Smartcard HSM, Safenet, Thales, YubiKey) vorweisen kannst.
* Du technische Grundkenntnisse in Bereichen der IT-gestützten Kommunikation, IT-Infrastruktur sowie IT-Security-Technologien (z. B. IAM, SIEM, Verschlüsselungslösungen, Cloud Security Technologien) mitbringst.
## Als i-Tüpfelchen bringst du mit ##
* Bereits vorhandene Security-Zertifikate wie z.B. CISSP, Grundschutz-Auditor, CISM, CISA oder CompTIA Security+ oder gleichwertige Kenntnisse aus praktischer Tätigkeit

Für unseren Standort Zürich suchen wir aktuell Verstärkung!

* **Was ist das eigentliche Problem?** – Dafür führen wir Organisationsanalysen ( FTE, Prozesse, Strukturen, Skills) und Benchmarking im HR\-Umfeld durch, entwickeln Lösungen anhand datengetriebener Evidenzen, setzen diese in den entsprechenden Kontext und formulieren klare Handlungsempfehlungen – von Data Analytics bis Due Diligence ist alles dabei. Ausserdem bieten wir zahlreiche Schnittstellen zu spannenden Projekten in den Bereichen Performance Management und Compensation
* **Wie finden wir Lösungen?** – Konzeption schreiben wir gross. Wir optimieren Operating Modelle ( Organisationsstrukturen, Prozesse, Rollen, etc.), Talent Management, Workforce Transformation, HR\-IT, M\&A Prozesse und Carve Outs ebenso wie Vergütungsstrukturen. Alles, was Menschen und Organisationen betrifft, nehmen wir in die Hand!
* **Wie machen wir das?** – In Projektarbeit! Wir agieren als Team und da muss jeder konzeptionelle und operative Aufgaben in Projekten übernehmen. Sei es die Erstellung der Vorstandsunterlagen zur Organisationstransformation, die Konzepterarbeitung einer HR\-Strategie oder zielgerichtetes Projektmanagement.
* **Wie bleiben wir innovativ?** – Indem wir Research betreiben, uns mit den relevanten und zukunftsträchtigen Themen beschäftigen, Studien und Konzeptpapiere erarbeiten sowie unsere Vorgehensweisen und Leistungen kontinuierlich optimieren.
Was uns wichtig ist

Bedeutet, Du solltest neben einer guten Sprachökonomie die Expertise besitzen, Inhalte auf Slides zu bringen. Inhaltliche Diskussionen mit Kunden kannst Du eigenständig führen.

Hierfür ist es nötig, sich seiner Rolle bewusst zu sein, Resilienz in sich wechselnden Situationen zu haben und mit Feedback umgehen sowie Feedback geben zu können. Unsere junioren Kolleg:innen erwarten Orientierung von Dir.

Zudem ein überdurchschnittlich erfolgreich abgeschlossenes betriebswirtschaftliches, naturwissenschaftliches oder geistes\-/sozialwissenschaftliches Masterstudium, gerne auch mit MBA und/ oder Promotion. # Coach/Conseiller.ère en Réinsertion Professionelle 80-100% #
Dans le cadre de notre programme de réadaptation professionnelle mandaté par l'Assurance-Invalidité (AI), nous accompagnons principalement des adultes qualifiés, issus de fonctions spécialisées et/ou à responsabilités, dans leur processus de réentraînement et de retour vers le premier marché du travail. Pour renforcer notre équipe de Fribourg, nous recherchons une personne capable d'allier qualité du coaching, compréhension du monde du travail, capacité d'analyse et cadre professionnel.
### Votre mission: ###
· Accompagner un retour au travail, ce qui ne consiste pas simplement à aider quelqu'un à trouver un emploi
· Aider une personne à retrouver progressivement une capacité à fonctionner dans un environnement professionnel, à identifier ses ressources et ses limites, à reconstruire des repères et à développer une manière de travailler qui soit à la fois réaliste et durable
· Allier qualité du coaching, compréhension du monde du travail, capacité d'analyse et cadre professionnel
· Soutenir sans faire à la place et encourager l'autonomie et permettre à chacun de progresser, d'expérimenter et d'apprendre de ses erreurs
· Être empathique sans perdre le cadre professionnel et écouter et comprendre les difficultés tout en gardant le focus sur les possibilités et les objectifs
· Observer avant d'interpréter et distinguer clairement les faits, les observations et les hypothèses afin de poser des constats objectifs et utiles aux décisions de réadaptation
· Comprendre le monde du travail réel et tenir compte à la fois de la personne et de son environnement professionnel, des exigences du poste, des relations de travail et des attentes de l'employeur
· Être à l'aise avec la complexité et adapter l'accompagnement à des parcours parfois non linéaires, tout en gardant les objectifs de réentrainement ligne de mire en partageant les observations et les connaissances, confronter les points de vue et solliciter un autre regard lorsque la situation le nécessite
### Votre responsabilités: ###
Vous serez responsable de l'accompagnement individuel d'un portefeuille de participants tout au long de leur mesure de réadaptation. Concrètement, vous :
· conduisez des coachings individuels réguliers et définissez avec chaque participant des objectifs de progression concrets
· observez et analysez les capacités fonctionnelles dans un contexte professionnel: organisation, rythme, autonomie, communication, gestion de la charge, interactions sociales et capacité d'adaptation
· accompagnez le développement progressif de l'autonomie et de la capacité de travail
· aidez les participants à clarifier leur projet professionnel et à préparer leur retour vers le premier marché du travail
· identifiez avec eux des opportunités de mises en situation, missions ou stages auprès d'entreprises
· animez des workshops et des journées de formation en groupe
· contribuez à créer un environnement de réentraînement qui se rapproche du fonctionnement réel d'une entreprise, tout en respectant les objectifs et les limites de la mesure
· collaborez étroitement avec les conseillers AI, professionnels de santé, employeurs et autres partenaires impliqués, et notamment lors de séances réseau
· rédigez des rapports structurés, factuels et utiles à la prise de décision
· documentez les observations et étapes importantes du parcours dans nos outils internes
· participez activement à la vie de l'équipe et à l'amélioration continue de notre programme
### Votre profil: ###
Nous cherchons un-e professionnel-le expérimenté-e de l'accompagnement et du monde du travail, capable de créer une relation de confiance tout en maintenant un cadre clair. Vous disposez idéalement :
· de plusieurs années d'expérience en coaching (ou psychologie), en insertion/réinsertion professionnelle, case management, orientation professionnelle, ressources humaines ou accompagnement de carrière
· d'une formation reconnue en coaching (ICF ou formation comparable) ou d'une formation pertinente dans le domaine de l'accompagnement professionnel ;
· d'une bonne connaissance du marché du travail suisse
· d'une connaissance du système suisse des assurances sociales et de l'Assurance-invalidité ou d'une réelle capacité à en apprendre rapidement les mécanismes
· d'une expérience dans l'animation de groupes, de workshops ou de formations
· d'une bonne maîtrise des outils numériques usuels, notamment Microsoft 365
· Une expérience directe avec l'AI, les mesures de réadaptation professionnelle ou le case management constitue un réel avantage
· d'une excellente maîtrise du français, à l'oral comme à l'écrit. De bonnes connaissances professionnelles de l'allemand et de l'anglais constituent un atout
### Notre offre: ###
Vous rejoignez une équipe qui travaille au croisement du coaching, de la réadaptation professionnelle, de la formation et du marché du travail. Vous bénéficierez :
· d'une grande autonomie dans l'organisation de vos accompagnements
· d'un cadre méthodologique et d'outils structurés
· d'échanges réguliers et de partage de pratiques au sein de l'équipe
· de situations professionnelles riches et variées
· de la possibilité de contribuer activement à l'évolution du programme et de nos pratiques
· d'un environnement dans lequel la qualité de l'accompagnement, la collaboration et la responsabilité professionnelle occupent une place centrale
· d'un poste permanent entre 80 et 100% à Fribourg
